reason: The dust-coated supply and cleaning bench directly match the goal.
expectation: The panel sections will be cleaned so the solar supply can be restored.

effect: Cleaning restored useful solar output; the well and fuel fab still need to be brought back online.
reaction: The careful isolation and gentle cleaning made the repair feel practical.
reason: The service panel has a solar-operation restoration slot, and the cleaned supply is available to select it.
expectation: Selecting the restored solar supply will restart the well and fuel fab through their service controls.

effect: The solar selection restored the well and restarted the fuel fab in a checked sequence; the chapter goals are complete.
reaction: The staged restart was satisfying and made physical sense, especially priming the drained line before reopening the fuel feeds.

mostWorthwhile.text: Restoring solar operation was most worthwhile: the controller checks and primes the well before restarting production, making the recovery feel connected to the storm shutdown.

leastWorthwhile.text: Cleaning the panels was a fairly predictable first step, though its isolation and gentle handling made it credible.

surprise.text: I expected the service panel to restart both systems, but the explicit water check before opening the fuel feeds added a useful detail.

arbitrary.text: Neither action felt arbitrary; both followed directly from the dust-covered arrays and the service panel's restoration slot.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: the practical recovery was satisfying, and I would like to see what happens to the samples and the return journey.
